notes.title: Beware the Wraith Guards
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Seekers.[/h2]

The world of Secret Seeker is expanding. The dimensions are shifting, and you're no longer alone out there...

[h3]New Enemy Mechanic: Dimensional Guards[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586735/f531b345438284827af5452e06f25d500441a694.gif[/img]

From now on, you may encounter Guards patrolling the dimensions in search of intruders. If they spot you, you have two choices: fight or hide. Waiting them out can be a safe option—but only if you’re well hidden. Be careful: if they catch you, it’s over. You’ll have to start the run from the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586735/cb189420a1486b50f43a3a9e8e5c11ad90f6e5a6.gif[/img]

To help you survive, we’ve added a brand-new item to the shop: the Invisibility Cloak. Use it to become completely undetectable to the Guards—for a limited time.

[h3]Puzzles and Dark Stories[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586735/819d2a740bec688263dcf881c0f7739271cf59e1.gif[/img]

Every level in Secret Seeker hides a deeper truth. Expect a variety of puzzles that test your logic, reflexes, observation, and sometimes—everything at once. The further you go, the more twisted the mysteries become.

[h3]Updated Store Page[/h3]

We’ve redesigned our Steam page, updated the game description to reflect new mechanics, and refreshed our logo. It’s the perfect time to wishlist the game if you haven’t already.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZTq9SdVpGC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586735/6ccd3cea36f9d31e896457391a1edabe6f5117bb.png[/img][/url]

More secrets are coming. Stay tuned and join us on Discord!

[h2]Secret Seeker Team[/h2]

notes.title: New Beta Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your involvement in beta testing! Based on your feedback, we’re making the game better!

*To ensure all changes update correctly, go to the options in the main menu and click the reset button.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h3]What’s New?[/h3]

[list]
[*] We’ve added a tutorial system based on interactive kiosks scattered throughout the HUB.
[*] You can now skip dialogues.
[*] Tooltips have been added when hovering over key UI elements.
[*] We’ve rebuilt the item preview system to work correctly.
[*] Minor rebalance of usable items.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed visible object LODs overlapping.
[*] Removed a critical bug that caused the game to freeze when pressing ESC in the item preview screen.
[*] Perks and usable items now display the correct descriptions.
[*] Fixed many minor bugs.
[/list]

[h1]Big changes on the horizon![/h1]

We're working on new mechanics that will completely change the gameplay! Your feedback on the gameplay experience has been invaluable. To meet your expectations, we’ve decided to introduce the following features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586735/2f964de09100f25895d7a70d41a67a3168c123f1.gif[/img]
[h3]Wraith Guards[/h3]
Powerful enemies are coming soon - eerie guardians patrolling dimensions, making sure no one is where they shouldn’t be. Guardians will appear randomly in levels and patrol the area. To avoid them, you’ll have two options:
[olist]
[*] Stealth: Hide and sneak past them unnoticed until they leave the dimension.
[*] Combat: Try to defeat them in battle - but it’s risky and will draw attention.
[/olist]

[h3]Secrets & Puzzles[/h3]
Every level will hide a secret waiting to be discovered. These will be multi-step puzzles that require attention and clever thinking. Solving them will earn you valuable rewards to help in future runs!
Beta testing is ongoing!

You still have the chance to help shape the project and play the game before release! Join the beta today — more info on our Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/YupE4hgwJD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586735/6ccd3cea36f9d31e896457391a1edabe6f5117bb.png[/img]
[/url]
Stay up to date and add Secret Seeker to your wishlist so you don’t miss any news!

[h3][i]*To ensure all changes update correctly, go to the options in the main menu and click the reset button.
[/i][/h3]

Secret Seeker Team
